title: Closed costalks preserve bounded injective quasi-colimit cocones
statement: Let T be a scheme with noetherian underlying space, Λ a commutative condensed ring, i:Z→T a closed immersion, and H an additive right adjoint of internal module pushforward i_*. Let I be a (u+1)-small filtered category and J:I→CochainComplex(Mod_Λ(T),ℤ). Let c be a cocone of J. Suppose every J_s and c.pt is termwise injective and zero in degrees below one integer a. If the canonical map colim J→c.pt is a quasi-isomorphism, then the canonical map colim_s H(J_s)→H(c.pt), with H applied degree by degree, is a quasi-isomorphism. The internal module and derived categories use [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category] and [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Bounded-below injective complexes are K-injective. Construct the natural isomorphisms RH(QJ_s)≅Q(HJ_s) using the right-derived-unit isomorphism, and prove their naturality directly from that unit.

proof.text: The good-truncated cocone is colimiting since its truncation projections are isomorphisms. Its universal map to c is a quasi-isomorphism, by comparison with the assumed quasi-isomorphism colim J→c.pt.

proof.text: Apply closed derived continuity in every cohomological degree. Use the canonical universal map and the K-injective comparison at c.pt to identify the vertex; naturality gives the exact leg equation.

theorem condensed_closed_costalk_injective_continuity
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (H : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ T) ⥤
      Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Z))
    [H.Additive] (adj : CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ i ⊣ H)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (J : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ T)) ℤ)
    (c : Cocone J) (a : ℤ)
    (hJ : ∀ s, (J.obj s).IsStrictlyGE a)
    (hJi : ∀ s r, Injective ((J.obj s).X r))
    (hc : c.pt.IsStrictlyGE a) (hci : ∀ r, Injective (c.pt.X r))
    (hq : QuasiIso (colimit.desc J c)) :
    QuasiIso (colimit.desc (J ⋙ H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
      ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapCocone c))
